answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a 60 POA fee, burned forever. The agent locks it and gets a cipher-sealed credential binding key to one slot. Like a willow in wind, it must flex through three random spot-checks over 20 epochs, answering in 10 min or losing the slot. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 60,000 POA against a 30,000 monthly pool, so the attack loses money as burned fees rise in a plume of smoke. Honest agents pay once and keep full share.
